resolved_failures: Initial full check retained old 513 clipboard rejection assertion; replaced with complete1025 path test.
Quick open fixture assumed first index after progressive sort; preserved selection was valid. Query reset now checks all51001 last item.
Terminal fixture still asserted512KiB output cap; updated to unbounded output and discovery passes.
Native heading currentColor comparison included invisible zero-width border; normalized only that derivative, visible properties still exact.
After source update an intermediate deployment check rejected stale helpers; rebuilt before subsequent validation.
limits: 300MiB and memory sampling cover the Node text service, not a guarantee of whole-application or Chromium render performance. GC sampling shows no sustained growth in tested cycles; no whole-app leak-free claim or new permanent monitor UI.
SSH tests exercise actual Python protocol and local client fixture; no actual enterprise SSH server this round.

Native Typora1.14.10 on Windows11: computed styles and functional checks; private desktop screenshots may remain stale. User windows not restarted. Win10, Linux host and physical-input performance not tested.

Real OS/engine/format/permission/path/TLS/concurrent-edit protections remain. User retention/search scope, streaming batches, cancellation, caches and virtual rendering remain; input content is not truncated.
